description: Ground truth for the dedicated validation/dataflow golden corpus (Phase 6 of the Analysis Correctness & Dataflow Verification spec). Each entry is a finding that SHOULD be produced when this corpus is analyzed with contract.json loaded via --contracts; any produced finding not listed here counts as a false positive. Covers the 16 explicitly required test groups (see the per-file comments in corpus/*.ts for which group each case belongs to): correct validation, missing validation, unused validator, result-ignored/raw-reuse-after-validation, validation in a separate never-called function, cross-function handoffs (both a validated-and-traced good path and a raw-and-unflagged-otherwise bad path), multiple .max() merging, multiple format AND-merging, an unresolvable Zod modifier, an AST-verified alias validator, a generic exception unrelated to the request, mass assignment via spread, security requirements Stoa cannot verify (must produce NOTHING), and conflicting FE/BE implementations under one trace ID.
